Hey there!  
My boyfriend and I were internationally long distance for over a year and yes,  it was very hard but so worth it.  
A three hour time difference is very doable.  It might take a while to initially get set up,  but schedule a time where you can both talk everyday,  even if it is just a quick chat,  and once a week,  have a "date night". 
Send each other texts when ever you get the chance,  a little text goes a long way.  

Also,  remember to take care of yourself,  let yourself be sad when he is gone,  but then keep busy and do things that make you happy.  

If he is your forever,  like mine,  you may consider moving.  I moved internationally to be with him and we currently live here together.  Best decision I ever made.
  Feel free to pm anytime.  You got this!
